cheapEat.name: Farinata at La Stuzzicheria
cheapEat.note: At La Stuzzicheria, Tue-Sun 10:30-21:00; Wikivoyage gives no price for this dish.

TRN.saveTip: Skip the pricey Bicerin at Caffe al Bicerin, which has long queues, and eat at Piola Cianci instead.

cheapEat.name: Arancino, fried rice ball
cheapEat.note: Sold for €1.50 at most places in Catania, per Wikivoyage's Fast food section.

CTA.saveTip: Eat an arancino or a cold panino at a fast-food counter, where Wikivoyage lists €1.50 and €1-3.

cheapEat.name: Panelle sandwich
cheapEat.note: €1.50-2.50 per Sluurpy; a Piazza Kalsa counter, Friggitoria Chiluzzo, charges €4.

PMO.saveTip: Il Proverbio near Quattro Canti keeps most Sicilian dishes at €4-6, so it is a budget sit-down option.

cheapEat.name: Panzerotto from Mastrociccio
cheapEat.note: City-centre counter, €3-6.50 in a June 2024 Gambero Rosso guide; check the current menu.

BRI.saveTip: For a sit-down meal, Osteria Vini e Cucina in the old town has a simple four-course menu for about €15.

cheapEat.name: Piadina wrap from La Caveja
cheapEat.note: Chain with big portions, per Wikivoyage; the listing gives no price.

TRS.saveTip: Takeaway pizza at Pizzeria la Napa or a big-portion piadina from La Caveja makes a quick lunch.

cheapEat.name: Takeaway pita souvlaki
cheapEat.note: Thanasis, Savvas or Bairaktaris at the end of Mitropoleos; around €1.70 (Wikivoyage).

ATH.saveTip: A takeaway pita souvlaki at about €1.70 costs far less than the plate at around €9 from the same shops.

cheapEat.name: Koulouri or stafidopsomo
cheapEat.note: Cost €0.50, sold in bakeries or on carts, per Wikivoyage's Eat section.

SKG.saveTip: Wikivoyage says a gyros is a meal for under €3, so it is a cheap lunch option.

cheapEat.name: Çiğ köfte wrap, takeaway
cheapEat.note: Ali Usta, Historical Peninsula: TRY 80 in a listing last edited Aug 2025 (about €1.45).

IST.saveTip: Börek from İbrahim Hakkı Uğrak in Galata opens at 05:00 and is good value, though not every type is ready early.

cheapEat.name: Mekitsa (Bulgarian breakfast)
cheapEat.note: 5 lev (about €2.56) at Mekitsa & Kafe, Graf Ignatiev St, in a May 2025 guide.

SOF.saveTip: Mekitsa and Coffee is listed under budget eats in Sofia, so it is a cheap place for breakfast.

cheapEat.name: Pastry from LUCA
cheapEat.note: Cheap Romanian pastry chain with branches across the city; Wikivoyage gives no price.

BUH.saveTip: Buy savoury pastries at LUCA, a cheap Romanian chain with locations all over the city and vegetarian options.
